# BOM-06 device, WebXR, WebGPU, and Presentation browser reference

Captured on **2026-11-25** using fresh temporary headless profiles in **Google
Chrome 158.0.8127.88**, macOS arm64, over a local CDP pipe with `--disable-gpu`,
external DNS disabled, and no user profile, hardware device, or user gesture.

- `probe.js` -> `chrome.json` (secure loopback HTTP) and `chrome-insecure.json`
  (insecure hostname mapped to loopback).
